# First Day

> The first day of the rest of your life.

## About

First Day is an AI-powered goal achievement platform that helps users accomplish any goal through personalized, structured 30-day plans. Users describe a goal, and the AI generates a day-by-day action plan with activities, tips, resources, and optional weekly book recommendations — all tailored to their experience level, schedule, and preferences.

- **URL**: https://firstday.life
- **Category**: Productivity / Self-Improvement / Goal Tracking

## Key Features

- **AI-Generated 30-Day Plans**: Describe any goal and receive a personalized plan with daily activities, tips, and curated resources (YouTube videos, articles, books).
- **Adaptive Scheduling**: Plans respect your time commitment, preferred time slots, and available days of the week.
- **Activity Tracking**: Check off daily activities, write reflections, and track completion across the full 30-day journey.
- **Engagement & Gamification**: XP system, streaks, leveling (Beginner through Master), achievements, and milestone celebrations keep users motivated.
- **Beast Mode**: An intensive mode for users who want to push harder on their goals.
- **Calendar View**: Visual overview of progress across the entire plan with day-by-day status.
- **Multiple Goals**: Manage and switch between multiple active goals simultaneously.
- **Demo Mode**: Try the full app experience without creating an account.
- **Notification Settings**: Configurable reminders to stay on track.

## How It Works

1. User enters a goal (e.g., "Learn to play guitar," "Run a 5K," "Launch a side business").
2. AI asks contextual follow-up questions based on the goal type.
3. A personalized 30-day plan is generated with daily activities and resources.
4. User completes activities day by day, earning XP and building streaks.
5. Milestones, achievements, and level-ups celebrate progress along the way.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
- **Animation**: Framer Motion 12
- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + Database)
- **UI**: Radix UI primitives, Lucide icons, Sonner toast notifications
- **Visual Design**: Custom Voronoi mosaic backgrounds (d3-delaunay), geometric shard-based design system
